svg.aria-label: z0d1akCTF 2026 Qualifiers Forensics writeup cover — all eight Forensics challenges solved. Black Box parses big-endian 16-byte records and XOR-decrypts five out-of-order flag fragments with the 0xDEAD key in the trailer slot. Dead Current carves a deleted CRIU ghost IRF1 record, parses gopclntab from a stripped Go binary, and recovers the master secret from pages-2.img after an empty type-4 length-zero incident marker. Dead Letter Wake reassembles seven MIME message-partial fragments across a PCAP and a Postfix deferred queue and inverts a PIX-8 mosaic via beam-searching DejaVu Sans 32 pixel through an RGB-channel-shifted forward model. Ghost in the GPU carves the single 1.5 MiB low-entropy survivor from a 32 MiB scrubbed VRAM dump and reads it as an fp16 mask reshaped to 1024 by 768. Hydra FC exploits a leaked source map that documents a naive sequence comparison and plots 326 confidence-equals-1.0 injected frames onto a mirrored QR code. layer-eight carves the deploy_key from OCI layer 4 despite layer 8 whiteouts and reassembles three sharded image labels into an AES-256-GCM envelope. 99.8% derives a qbcn key from a memory-dump domain plus torrent piece window plus piece-length word and decrypts an HREG container in the partfile's final piece. Unrotated correlates seven artifacts across identity, application, governance, host journal, container OCI, network firewall, physical patch panel, and ANSI cursor cast into a seven-line incident report accepted by the TLS service
